subject: Private environment isolation + capacity surge — term amendment & SLA alignment
messages:
From: Laura Martinez <laura.martinez@medataiq.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medataiq.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity surge + tenancy split for Q3 — can we scope?

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood Private. We ran a short internal runbook against production-like traffic and have two asks as we approach our contract renewal (end of June):

1) Isolation: We need a logical tenancy split for analytics vs. inference workloads (separate clusters with network isolation and distinct KMS keys).
2) Short-term surge: We expect a 3x token/throughput spike for a 6-week pilot starting 2028-07-10; we want reserved burst capacity and clearer SLA for degraded fallback behavior.

I've attached a capacity matrix with expected p95 traffic by endpoint. Can you confirm what lead time and price delta we'd expect for the split and the short-term reserved burst? Also, we'd like to understand what changes (if any) are needed to our existing on-prem connectivity.

Thanks,
Laura
Director of Platform Engineering
MedataIQ

[attachment: medataiq_capacity_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Laura Martinez <laura.martinez@medataiq.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity surge + tenancy split for Q3 — can we scope?

Laura — thanks for the clear ask and the matrix, this helps. High-level answers below and I captured a couple of follow-ups so we can scope the amendment quickly: 

- Isolation: We can provision two private clusters (analytics and inference) with VPC-level isolation and separate KMS envelopes. Typical lead time for provisioning two clusters on your current Dedicated footprint is ~4–6 weeks; on-prem airgapped installs take longer (we'll confirm after reviewing network readiness).

- Burst/reserved capacity: We can offer a 6-week reserved burst window with guaranteed capacity and an SLA addendum for failed fallbacks. Pricing for the burst is typically a fixed uplift on your Dedicated commit plus per-hour reserved usage for the window. I put a rough ballpark in the attached draft term amendment (v1).

Action items: 
1) Karthik — can you confirm the configuration options and a quick delta quote for a 2-cluster split + 6-week burst? Please include estimated lead times for both hosted Private (Redwood-managed infra) and on-prem (customer-managed infra).
2) Neha — can you check whether adding separate KMS envelopes will impact our legal data processing appendices and call out any additional compliance steps?
3) Laura/Samir — can you confirm whether you prefer a Redwood-managed Private deployment or an on-prem package for the analytics cluster? That choice affects lead time and pricing.

I'll assemble a draft SOW + term amendment once we have the answers.

— Hannah
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Martinez <laura.martinez@medataiq.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@medataiq.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity surge + tenancy split for Q3 — can we scope?

Laura / Hannah — digging into the matrix. Quick technical notes: 

- Two-cluster split: For your traffic profile we recommend:
  * Inference cluster: 4x A100-equivalent nodes (quantized models, KV caching enabled)
  * Analytics cluster: 2x high-memory T4-equivalent nodes for batch embedding/analytics.
  * Network isolation via separate VPCs + route ACLs; separate KMS envelopes as requested.

- Lead times: Redwood-managed Private: 3–5 weeks (we can compress to 2.5 weeks with an approved expedite fee and pre-provisioned images). On-prem airgapped: 6–8 weeks (depends on your infra readiness doc).

- Burst window: We can allocate a reserved burst pool that attaches to the inference cluster; pricing is: 40% uplift on committed rate for the 6-week window + per-hour reserved node pricing. Fallback semantics: if the burst capacity is exhausted we will failover to a compatible public-hosted variant (with >=90% of primary latency) unless you opt-out — fallback will be explicitly covered in the SLA addendum.

I'll generate a line-item quote and a technical SOW draft by EOD Thu (04 Apr).

— Karthik
VP, Field Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: MedataIQ Legal <legal@medataiq.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Apr 2028 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity surge + tenancy split for Q3 — term amendment & SLA alignment

Looping in finance/legal notes and the next steps. Laura/Samir — thanks for the context, this is all actionable. Two quick commercial items for your review: 

1) Term amendment: We prepared draft-term-amendment-v2.docx (attached). It includes: cluster split charges, 6-week burst fee, SLA fallback language, and KMS envelope handling.
2) Payment / procurement: For a mid-term add, standard flow is: signed amendment + 30% upfront payment on the incremental committed spend, balance on go-live. If you need net-45 payment terms we can flag this to RevOps but it will require an approval queue.

Please review the attached draft. Hannah — once MedataIQ confirms Redwood-managed vs on-prem for analytics cluster and whether they want fallback opt-out, I'll route to RevOps and Legal for final pricing/term approval.

Thanks — Marcus
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
